newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Renault chief to meet Belgian unions Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Renault chief to meet Belgian unions Wednesday.

text.p: Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer has agreed to discuss with Belgian unions on Wednesday whether to keep the carmakers' plant at Vilvoorde open, a union spokesman said.
"He has said he is willing to talk about...keeping Vilvoorde open...because for us that was a condition to start talks," Karel Gacoms told Reuters.
"It doesn't mean he said he has agreed (to keeping the plant open)...but he wants to handle that issue," Gacoms said.
"You should see this as a first contact. Don't think that an arrangement can be found on Wednesday," he said.

He added that Karel Vinck, chief executive officer of Belgian non-ferrous metals firm Union Miniere (UM), and Jean Gandois, the French employers' federation chief and chairman of Belgian steel maker Cockerill Sambre, were making the first contacts with Schweitzer.
